name: codex-extras
description: Codex conversations in Agent Work Plan's work plan and Conversations views, a Codex session list, and a Codex button on the tab bar.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode nothing is installed into Codex, Codex is not patched and no file is written.

codexExtras.codexHome.markdownDescription: The Codex home directory to read and to install the work plan plugin into. Empty uses `CODEX_HOME` when it is set, otherwise `~/.codex`.

codexExtras.enabled.markdownDescription:
The master switch over the additions this extension makes to Codex: the time on each message, the list of your own messages, their colouring, the chimes, the figures strip, the dot on a tab's logo and the count in the status bar, and whether Codex is patched at all. Off leaves each of their own settings as you had it, and turns them back on as they were.

It does **not** take an applied patch out of Codex's files. The patch stays where it is and nothing is drawn through it; `Codex Extras: Remove the Patch from Codex` is what puts Codex's own files back.

The work plan and the Codex session list are not covered by it, and have their own settings.

codexExtras.workPlan.markdownDescription: Keep a work plan for each Codex conversation: the open rows put in front of the model every turn, and the reminders at the end of one. Agent Work Plan draws the plans. Off makes the hooks say nothing and refuse to change a plan, and no Codex plan is shown.

codexExtras.installWorkPlanPlugin.markdownDescription: Whether to install the work plan plugin into Codex when it is missing or is not the one this extension ships: another version, or other files under the same version.
enumDescriptions: Ask once per Codex home and set of plugin files
Install without asking; Codex still asks you to trust its hooks
Never install it; use the command

codexExtras.sessionList.markdownDescription: Show the **Codex sessions** view in the Codex Extras sidebar: the conversations open in this window, recently closed ones, and the rest by Codex's own sections.

codexExtras.sessionsInWorkspaceOnly.markdownDescription: List only conversations started in this window's workspace folders, or folders under them, in Codex sessions (open and recently closed ones are always listed).

codexExtras.hideBackgroundSessions.markdownDescription: Leave out the threads Codex starts by itself - sub-agents and the reviews of approval requests - and `codex exec` runs.

codexExtras.recentClosedSessions.markdownDescription: How many conversations **Recently closed** lists. 0 hides it.

codexExtras.reopenDroppedTabs.markdownDescription: Reopen the Codex tabs that were open when the window closed but that VS Code did not restore, as can happen after the window lost its remote connection. Tabs you closed while connected stay closed.

enumDescriptions: The first editor group, the one a split is made from
The group the button was pressed in, which with a split open is the half you pressed it in
codexExtras.newConversationGroup.markdownDescription: Which editor group a new Codex conversation opens in.

enumDescriptions: A new Codex conversation in a tab
codexExtras.openButtonTarget.markdownDescription: What the Codex button on the tab bar opens.

codexExtras.tellCodexYourTimeZone.markdownDescription: Tell Codex the time zone you read in, when it differs from the machine Codex runs on, so it gives you times in your zone. The zone is the one Codex's page runs in. Nothing is said while Codex's own page has already told the model that zone in the conversation (it does at the start of every conversation it drives), so this speaks in `codex exec`, the terminal client, sub-agents, and after a compaction or a long stretch of conversation.

codexExtras.workPlanOfferMinTurns.markdownDescription: How many messages you must have sent before a conversation without a plan is offered one.

codexExtras.workPlanOfferMinToolCalls.markdownDescription: How many tool calls one turn must make before that offer.

codexExtras.workPlanQuietWhenReplyMatche.markdownDescription: A regular expression (Python syntax) tested on the latest reply. A match silences the reminders around a compaction, for conversations relaying another model's replies word for word.

codexExtras.patchCodex.markdownDescription: Whether to patch the Codex extension's own files for the additions that need it: status dots on Codex tabs, opening a given conversation in the sidebar, answers put into a conversation's message box, chimes, the line of turn figures, message and reply times, the list of your own messages down the right edge, and the colouring of your own messages. Codex's originals are kept beside them and put back by **Codex Extras: Remove the Patch from Codex** or on uninstall.

codexExtras.chime.markdownDescription: With the patch: a short sound in a Codex tab when a turn there finishes, when its work plan asks you something, or when it stops for your permission. Three notes is the permission one. A conversation with no tab open in this window cannot make a sound, since the sound is made in the tab's page.

codexExtras.waitingInStatusBar.markdownDescription: With the patch: a count in the status bar while Codex is stopped waiting for your permission, in any conversation of **this window**. Clicking it goes to that conversation. Hidden when there is none.

codexExtras.turnFigures.markdownDescription: With the patch: beside the time on each reply, that turn's context use, model and effort; and a line at the bottom right of a Codex tab with the last turn's, and the tool call running now. A turn's duration is left to Codex's own "Worked for".

codexExtras.timestamps.markdownDescription: With the patch: the time above every message and every reply block in a Codex conversation, in your own time zone. For a reply, Codex records the time on the block itself. For one of your own messages, the time comes from the clock Codex shows on hover, or failing that from the conversation's rollout, and is left off altogether when the rollout and the page disagree on how many of your messages there are.

codexExtras.conversationNavigation.markdownDescription: With the patch: a strip on the right edge of a Codex conversation listing your own messages by time and opening words. Click one to scroll to it, step with the arrows or with `,` and `.`, filter the list, or jump to the top or the bottom.

codexExtras.userMessageColor.markdownDescription: With the patch: the text colour of **your own messages** in a Codex conversation, as a CSS colour, for example `#90EE90`, `lightgreen` or `rgb(144,238,144)`. Leave it empty to keep Codex's own colour.

codexExtras.userMessageEdge.markdownDescription: With the patch: a bar down the leading edge of **your own messages** in a Codex conversation, in the theme's focus colour. Off leaves Codex's own bubble as it is.

codexExtras.sendAnswers.markdownDescription: With the patch: an answer from Agent Work Plan's Answer view is sent into the conversation, as pressing Enter in Codex's message box would; while a turn is running Codex queues it or steers the turn with it, as with anything you send then. Off leaves it in the message box as a draft for you to send. Either way it goes in only when the box is empty.

codexExtras.lowContextOutline.markdownDescription: With the patch: an outline round Codex's own context meter in the message box once 85% or more of the context window is used. Codex shows that meter only with its own setting on: in Codex's settings, General, Composer, **Show context window usage**.
